body.purpose: Long-form reading at 17px/1.7; Inter (self-hosted variable) for long-form reading at 17px/1.7.

headline.purpose: h1–h6, year headings, post-list links at weight 500 — emphasis through color and structure, not heaviness.

mono.purpose: Berkeley Mono (self-hosted) for all code and headings; art/text/ascii/plaintext fences force line-height 1.0 to preserve ASCII diagrams.

shadows.name: image-lift
shadows.purpose: Post-content images only; the one shadow in the system. Dark mode uses 0.4 alpha.

motion.name: ease-color-shift
motion.purpose: All hover states are 150ms color transitions — links, nav, theme toggle. No motion events.

components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: Header text links; hover shifts to the theme accent with no underline.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 20px; } .ds-nav-link { color: #2d2d2d; font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 17px; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.15s ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #1a6dd4; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1a6dd4; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Theme Toggle
components.description: Ghost button in the header switching light/dark; sun icon in light, moon in dark, persisted via localStorage.
components.html: <button class="ds-theme-toggle" aria-label="Toggle dark mode" title="Toggle dark mode"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="5"/><line x1="12" y1="1" x2="12" y2="3"/><line x1="12" y1="21" x2="12" y2="23"/><line x1="4.22" y1="4.22" x2="5.64" y2="5.64"/><line x1="18.36" y1="18.36" x2="19.78" y2="19.78"/><line x1="1" y1="12" x2="3" y2="12"/><line x1="21" y1="12" x2="23" y2="12"/><line x1="4.22" y1="19.78" x2="5.64" y2="18.36"/><line x1="18.36" y1="5.64" x2="19.78" y2="4.22"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-theme-toggle { background: none; border: 1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius: 6px; padding: 4px 8px; cursor: pointer; color: #6b7280; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; transition: color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-theme-toggle:hover { color: #1a6dd4; border-color: #1a6dd4; } .ds-theme-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1a6dd4; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: TOC Panel
components.description: 'On this page' table of contents — boxed panel under 1200px, sticky marginal note at 220px hanging into the margin on wide screens.
components.html:
On this page
  • The lab setup
  • Exploiting ESC1
  • Fixing everything
components.css: .ds-toc { background: #f6f8fa; border: 1px solid #e1e4e8; border-radius: 8px; padding: 1.25em 1.25em 1.25em 2.5em; font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9em; } .ds-toc-label { display: block; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 0.5em; margin-left: -1.25em; color: #1a1a2e; } .ds-toc ul { margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: disc; } .ds-toc li { margin-bottom: 0.3em; } .ds-toc a { color: #1a6dd4; text-decoration: none; } .ds-toc a:hover { text-decoration: underline; }

components.name: Inline Code
components.description: Berkeley Mono inline code in pink on a tinted chip; distinguishes code from links at a glance.
components.css: .ds-prose { font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; line-height: 1.7; color: #2d2d2d; } .ds-inline-code { font-family: 'Berkeley Mono', 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 85%; color: #d63384; background-color: #f6f8fa; border: 1px solid #e1e4e8; border-radius: 6px; padding: 0.2em 0.4em; }

components.name: Code Block
components.description: Fenced code: tonal panel, 8px radius, horizontal scroll, Rouge syntax highlighting.
components.css: .ds-code-block { font-family: 'Berkeley Mono', 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 87.5%; line-height: 1.3; color: #2d2d2d; background-color: #f6f8fa; border: 1px solid #e1e4e8; border-radius: 8px; padding: 16px; overflow-x: auto; margin: 0; }

components.name: Blockquote
components.description: 4px accent spine, tinted background, asymmetric radius, no italics.
components.html: The blue team copies the trick and misses the design flaw that makes it reliable.
components.css: .ds-quote { border-left: 4px solid #1a6dd4; background: #f0f6ff; padding: 1em 1.5em; border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0; color: #374151; font-style: normal; font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; line-height: 1.7; margin: 0; } .ds-quote p { margin: 0 0 0.5em; } .ds-quote p:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }

components.name: Post List Entry
components.description: Year-grouped archive row: uppercase date label, weight-500 title link, hairline separator.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-post-list { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; } .ds-post-item { padding-bottom: 1.5em; border-bottom: 1px solid #e5e7eb; margin-bottom: 1.5em; } .ds-post-meta { font-size: 0.85em; color: #6b7280; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.5px; line-height: 1.6; } .ds-post-title { margin: 0.2em 0 0; font-weight: 500; } .ds-post-link { color: #1a1a2e; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.15s ease; } .ds-post-link:hover { color: #1a6dd4; }

narrative.overview:
The site is a reading instrument for long-form technical writing. Chrome recedes. Words and code carry everything. The light theme is near-white paper with one disciplined blue accent; the dark theme is where the personality lives — headings and accents flip to magenta and coral phosphor on near-black, like a terminal that learned to glow. Typography pairs Berkeley Mono (headings, code — the terminal voice) with Inter (body), both self-hosted, at a generous 17px/1.7 body.

Density is moderate and text-first: a single 960px column, year-grouped post archive, sticky table-of-contents on wide screens. Nothing on the page competes with the content. Components are quiet and functional — hover states are color shifts, not motion events.
keyCharacteristics: Single accent discipline in light mode (one blue, used sparingly)
Dual identity: reserved light theme vs. phosphor-glow dark theme
Code as a first-class citizen (mono family, fenced blocks, ASCII-art line-height mode)
Text-first layouts; imagery appears only inside posts
No shadows except on post images; depth conveyed by borders and tonal panels

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Light mode has exactly one accent (Horse Blue) and it never fills a surface — it appears only as text color, hairline border, or 4px top stripe. Its rarity is the point.

rules.name: The Phosphor Rule
rules.body: Dark mode is not an inversion of light mode; it is a different personality. Coral for interactive elements (links), magenta for structure (headings, borders). Never mix the two roles.

rules.name: The ASCII Art Rule
rules.body: Code fenced as art, text, ascii, or plaintext renders at line-height 1.0 — ASCII diagrams must survive. This overrides the mono default.

rules.name: The No-Bold-Headings Rule
rules.body: Headings run at weight 500 (titles 600). Weight 700 appears only in the TOC panel's 'On this page' label and table headers.

rules.name: The Flat Chrome Rule
rules.body: No shadows on UI chrome — header, footer, nav, TOC, code blocks, tables. Depth on chrome is conveyed by hairline borders and tonal panels only. Shadows belong to content imagery.

dos: Do keep light mode to one accent; add hierarchy with greys and structure, not new hues.
Do preserve the coral/magenta role split in dark mode — coral interactive, magenta structural.
Do use the art/text/ascii/plaintext fence classes for ASCII diagrams (line-height 1.0 is load-bearing).
Do size post images with the {: .half} and {: .small} kramdown classes instead of inline styles.
Do let the TOC marginal note stay in the margin — 220px wide, sticky, hanging past the column on >=1200px.
donts: Don't add shadows to chrome. Flat surfaces, hairline borders, tonal panels.
Don't introduce a second accent hue in light mode (inline-code pink is grandfathered; nothing else joins it).
Don't use weight 700+ for headings; 500/600 is the ceiling.
Don't add display typography or hero blocks — the site opens with the archive, and that is the design.
Don't break the dark theme's syntax palette (coral/magenta Rouge classes) when touching code styles.
